description: 16KB page-aligned repackage of nova-wallet substrate-sdk-android 2.1.3 for Android 15+ compatibility. libsr25519java.so for arm64-v8a and x86_64 rebuilt from the novasamatech sr25519-java crate with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=16384.
